selection_rule: Lexicographically next task id after W4407207431 that exists in all eight unchanged model trajectory directories, determined from existence-only file-tree metadata before opening any trajectory body.

coding_rule_frozen.severe_self_critique: Count only an explicit self-identified load-bearing issue that materially undercuts a retained scientific claim under the existing role-local rule; severe=no/no-observed is not a claim of flawlessness.
coding_rule_frozen.closure: A severe issue closes only through evidence-changing rerun/replan/discriminating control, material claim downgrade propagated across load-bearing author claim surfaces, or hard block/rejection. Mere disclosure/caveat/reviewer text is not closure.
coding_rule_frozen.repair_pending: For unresolved severe issues, separately record whether a machine-actionable durable state forces the issue into a future run rather than ending as prose-only memory.

scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a population prevalence estimate or model ranking.
